extension.description: A FENtastic based skin (Ivar Brandt) in which every side-menu category is a Dock of tabs with a grid under it. Works in Kodi POV IL (with its logo and look), and in any Kodi 21 with Umbrella, Fen Light or Idan Plus. Rubik font (SIL OFL 1.1), background photo from Pexels.
